Our Services

Lakeside Dental Care provides general and cosmetic dentistry in Seattle. Cleanings, fillings, crowns, veneers, implants and emergency care. We have been in the Lake Union neighbourhood since 2011 and see patients from across Seattle.

New Patients

New patient exams include a full set of x-rays and a cleaning. We accept most PPO insurance plans and offer in-house payment plans for larger treatment. Evening appointments are available on Tuesdays and Thursdays until 7pm for patients who cannot take time off work.

Our Team

Dr. Ellen Roche and Dr. Marcus Webb lead a team of eight. Both are members of the American Dental Association and have practised in Seattle for over fifteen years between them. Our hygienists average nine years with us.

Insurance and Payment

We are in-network with Delta Dental, Cigna, Aetna, Premera and Regence. For patients without insurance we offer a membership plan covering two cleanings, exams and x-rays annually.
